title.en: How Many Seconds Does the Cache Save?

hints.tr: `for number, changed in enumerate(builds):` ve her derlemede `running = number == 0`.
hints.en: `for number, changed in enumerate(builds):` and in each build `running = number == 0`.

hints.tr: Adım döngüsünde: `if set(files) & set(changed): running = True`, sonra `if running: total += seconds`.
hints.en: In the step loop: `if set(files) & set(changed): running = True`, then `if running: total += seconds`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def total_seconds(steps, builds):
    total = 0
    for number, changed in enumerate(builds):
        running = number == 0
        for instruction, files, seconds in steps:
            if set(files) & set(changed):
                running = True
            if running:
                total += seconds
    return total


good = [
    ["FROM python:3.13-slim", [], 5],
    ["COPY requirements.txt .", ["requirements.txt"], 1],
    ["RUN pip install -r requirements.txt", [], 60],
    ["COPY . .", ["app.py", "requirements.txt"], 1],
    ["CMD python app.py", [], 0],
]
bad = [
    ["FROM python:3.13-slim", [], 5],
    ["COPY . .", ["app.py", "requirements.txt"], 1],
    ["RUN pip install -r requirements.txt", [], 60],
    ["CMD python app.py", [], 0],
]
builds = [[], ["app.py"], ["app.py"], ["requirements.txt"], ["app.py"]]
print("good order:", total_seconds(good, builds))
print("bad order:", total_seconds(bad, builds))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def total_seconds(steps, builds):
    total = 0
    for number, changed in enumerate(builds):
        running = number == 0
        for instruction, files, seconds in steps:
            if set(files) & set(changed):
                running = True
            if running:
                total += seconds
    return total


good = [
    ["FROM python:3.13-slim", [], 5],
    ["COPY requirements.txt .", ["requirements.txt"], 1],
    ["RUN pip install -r requirements.txt", [], 60],
    ["COPY . .", ["app.py", "requirements.txt"], 1],
    ["CMD python app.py", [], 0],
]
bad = [
    ["FROM python:3.13-slim", [], 5],
    ["COPY . .", ["app.py", "requirements.txt"], 1],
    ["RUN pip install -r requirements.txt", [], 60],
    ["CMD python app.py", [], 0],
]
builds = [[], ["app.py"], ["app.py"], ["requirements.txt"], ["app.py"]]
print("good order:", total_seconds(good, builds))
print("bad order:", total_seconds(bad, builds))
```
